Module Contents¶

jam.utils.codec.composite — Container Type Codecs¶

Codec implementations for composite JAM types.

Available Codecs¶

  • ArrayCodec: Fixed-length sequences [T; N]

  • VectorCodec: Dynamic-length sequences [len][T…]

  • DictionaryCodec: Key-value mappings [len][K V…]

  • ChoiceCodec: Tagged unions [tag][value]

  • BitSequenceCodec: Packed bit sequences [len?][bits…]

Encoding Format¶

Fixed Arrays:

[item0][item1]...[itemN-1]  # No length prefix
Maximum size: 1000 elements

Dynamic Vectors:

[Length_Tag: varint][Length_Data: varies][Elements...]
Length encoding:
    0x00-0xFC: Direct value (1 byte)
    0xFF: u16 value (3 bytes)
    0xFE: u24 value (4 bytes)
    0xFD: u32 value (5 bytes)

Dictionaries:

[Length_Tag: varint][Length_Data: varies][Pairs...]
where each Pair is:
    [Encoded Key][Encoded Value]
Pairs are sorted by encoded key bytes

Choices:

[Tag: varint][Value]
Tag indexes into choices list
Value encoded based on tag type

Bit Sequences:

Fixed length:
    [bits packed into bytes]
Dynamic length:
    [Length: varint][bits packed into bytes]
Bits packed LSB/MSB order

Implementation Details¶

Array Validation:

def encode_into(value: Sequence[Codable], buffer: bytearray, offset: int) -> int:
    if len(value) != self.length:
        raise EncodeError(f"Expected {self.length} elements, got {len(value)}")
    for item in value:
        written = item.encode_into(buffer, current_offset)
        current_offset += written
    return current_offset - offset

Dictionary Sorting:

def encode_into(value: Mapping[K,V], buffer: bytearray, offset: int) -> int:
    # Sort pairs by encoded key bytes
    pairs = sorted(
        value.items(),
        key=lambda x: self._encode_pair(x[0], x[1], temp_buffer, 0)[0]
    )
    # Encode length and pairs
    current_offset = offset + encode_length(len(pairs))
    for key, val in pairs:
        current_offset += key.encode_into(buffer, current_offset)
        current_offset += val.encode_into(buffer, current_offset)
    return current_offset - offset

Examples

Fixed array:

from jam.utils.codec.composite import ArrayCodec
from jam.utils.codec.primitives import u32_codec

# Array[u32; 2]
codec = ArrayCodec(2)
encoded = codec.encode([1, 2])  # -> [01 00 00 00 02 00 00 00]

Dynamic vector:

from jam.utils.codec.composite import VectorCodec
from jam.utils.codec.primitives import string_codec

# Vector[String]
codec = VectorCodec(str, string_codec)
encoded = codec.encode(["a", "b"])
# -> [02 01 61 01 62]  # len=2, "a", "b"

Dictionary:

from jam.utils.codec.composite import DictionaryCodec
from jam.utils.codec.primitives import string_codec, u32_codec

# Dict[String, u32]
codec = DictionaryCodec(str, int, string_codec, u32_codec)
encoded = codec.encode({"a": 1, "b": 2})
# -> [02 01 61 01 00 00 00 01 62 02 00 00 00]

See also

  • jam.utils.codec.Codec: Base codec interface

  • jam.utils.codec.primitives: Basic type codecs

class jam.utils.codec.composite.ArrayCodec(length: int)[source]¶

Bases: Codec[Sequence[Codable]]

Codec for fixed-length arrays/sequences.

Arrays are encoded by concatenating their encoded elements in order. The length is fixed and known at encoding/decoding time.

class jam.utils.codec.composite.ChoiceCodec(choices: ~typing.Dict[str, ~typing.Type[~jam.utils.codec.codable.Codable[~jam.utils.codec.composite.choices.T]]], _ChoiceCodec__tag_codec: ~jam.utils.codec.codec.Codec[int] = <jam.utils.codec.primitives.integers.GeneralCodec object>)[source]¶

Bases: Codec[T], Generic[T]

Codec for choice/union values.

Choice values are encoded with a tag byte indicating the selected type, followed by the encoded value of that type.

The tag is encoded as a general integer, followed by the encoded value of the selected type. The tag value corresponds to the index of the type in the choices list.

Parameters:

  • choices – A list of types that are allowed for this choice. Their index will be used as the tag.

  • tag_codec – A codec for the tag. Defaults to GeneralCodec() [Best for most cases]. Alternatively we can use FixedInt(U8) for a fixed size tag if choices > 128.

Raises:

ValueError – If choices list is empty

class jam.utils.codec.composite.DictionaryCodec[source]¶

Bases: Codec[Mapping[K, V]], Generic[K, V]

Codec for key-value mappings.

Dictionaries are encoded as length-prefixed sequences of key-value pairs, sorted by encoded key bytes for deterministic encoding.

class jam.utils.codec.composite.BitSequenceCodec(bit_length: int | None = None, bit_order: Literal['msb', 'lsb'] = 'msb')[source]¶

Bases: Codec[Sequence[bool]]

Codec for encoding and decoding sequences of bits.

Bits are packed into octets (bytes) from least significant to most significant. IMP: It adds bit length encoded as a single byte at the beginning of the sequence ONLY if the bit length is not provided.

If dynamic length sequence:

  • Initialise with None

  • No need to pass bit length to decode_from

If fixed length sequence:

  • Initialise with bit length

  • Pass bit length to decode_from
